trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: Did you feel the mountain shake just now? That's our boss at work. You're too late!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: Too late or not, you're too strong for me.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: The peak is one floor up, and I'm what stands between it and you!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: Nothing stands between it and you now. Lucky you.
